import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from wordcount import count_words


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("text", "expected"),
    [("", 0), ("  \n\t ", 0), ("one two\nthree", 3)],
)
def test_count_words(text, expected):
    assert count_words(text) == expected


def test_cli_prints_file_word_count(tmp_path):
    text_file = tmp_path / "words.txt"
    text_file.write_text("hello from the CLI\n", encoding="utf-8")

    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).with_name("wordcount.py")), str(text_file)],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )

    assert result.stdout == "4\n"
